> Use this endpoint to update and end [Live Activities](https://www.braze.com/docs/developer_guide/platform_integration_guides/swift/live_activities/live_activities/) displayed by your iOS app. This endpoint requires additional setup. 
  

To use this endpoint, youll need to generate an API key with the `messages.live_activity.update` permission.

Before using this endpoint, you must register an activity with the Braze Swift SDK using the [`launchActivity`](https://braze-inc.github.io/braze-swif
